name: SymbolRegisterInt32
note: Registers an int32 script symbol in the game-data symbol table. Params: sym_buf = symbol-table context, sym_addr = address of the int32 value to register. Use during game-data symbol setup alongside the Bool8/Int16/Real32 variants.
rationale: Current signature literally reads 'SymbolRegisterInt16' - copy-paste bug; Int32 variant must share the correct name. Param shape proven identical to sibling registrars.

name: Config_SetContentControlPassword
note: Sets the content-control (parental lock) password. Param: password = password string as typed on the options screen. Use in config scripts / options UI. Returns 1.
rationale: signature field named GO_ContentControlPW while entry name is Config_SetContentControlPassword - name mismatch fixed to match entry; same address 0x00403C10 as GO_ContentControlPW (same retail native registered under both contexts).

name: ResourceLoad
note: Loads a resource file into memory. Params: resource_file = virtual resource path, buffer = receives pointer to loaded data. Returns pointer to the resource record (eax).
rationale: missing semicolon; r2dec header confirms exactly 2 stack args (arg_ch,arg_10h); body returns eax twice -> pointer return.

name: QTaskHashTableSet
signature: void QTaskHashTableSet(int** symbol,int ptr_func,int symbol_val,int p4,int p5,int p6,int p7);
note: Core registrar used by GAME_DEFINE_OPTIONS: inserts (name/address) pairs into the native-function hash table. This is the function every script-command registration site calls - do not invoke directly unless building a custom registrar.
rationale: missing semicolon; 7-arg layout matches all observed registration sites (push argc/push flags/push funcAddr/push nameStr/call 0x4BAAC0 pattern via wrapper 0x4B8890).

name: WeaponsCountGet
note: RETURNS the number of weapon entries defined for the human player (cycle table count at 0x56DF18 written by DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCycle). Takes no args. Use to bounds-check weapon indexes.
rationale: missing semicolon; 6-byte getter returning eax (pass1 thunk audit).

name: PlayerXPHit
note: Reads the player XP/hit byte: returns byte [PlayerPtr+0xE1]. Takes no args. Documented alias of HUMAN_HIT_DAMAGE - same address.
rationale: missing semicolon; machine-verified single read of PlayerPtr+0xE1 (sdk-round verification).

name: IsPlayerProfileActive
note: RETURNS pointer to the ACTIVE PROFILE's graphic-options/config record: computed as 0xBC2388 + 0xD14*[0xBC2384] (verified against retail defaults-reset fcn.00403B70 which walks the same layout). Takes no args. Despite the historical name this returns a record pointer, not a bool.
rationale: Layout cross-proven by two independent functions (this + Config_GetActiveGraphicOptions 0x404590 computing 0xBC2394 base); missing semicolon.

name: SymbolRemove
note: Removes a symbol from the game-data symbol table. Params: p1 = symbol-table context, symbol_name = name/reference of the symbol to remove.
rationale: typo 'SymbolRemo' in signature; 2-arg shape confirmed by r2dec header (arg_4h-based pair).

name: Game_CutsceneDelete

rationale: registration site 0x415787 pushes 0,0 before address => argc=0 - old signature claimed 'char* buffer'; no such argument exists at the verified registration site.

name: LogAdd
note: Writes a line to the engine debug log. Params: log_msg = text to log, log_channel = log target/channel selector (large 0x404-byte staging buffer inside - long strings are copied safely).
rationale: r2dec header detects TWO args (arg_404h, arg_408h) - old 1-param claim contradicted by decompiler; second param semantics uncertain (channel vs level) - flagged for runtime confirm.

name: ErrorShow
note: Shows a FATAL ERROR box ('Fatal error:\n\n' prefix string at this function) and aborts. Params: err_msg = message text (printf-style content observed), code = severity/exit code observed -1 in retail calls. Do not call casually - retail uses it for unrecoverable errors.
rationale: r2dec header detects 2 args (arg_10h,arg_14h); retail call sites push msg + -1. Old 1-param claim incomplete.

name: WarningShow
note: Shows a non-fatal WARNING box. Params: warn_msg = warning text, code = warning class observed -1 in retail calls. Use for recoverable script problems instead of ErrorShow.
rationale: r2dec header detects 2 args (arg_10h,arg_14h); same family as ErrorShow.

name: MusicSetVolume
note: Sets BOTH music engine volumes (likely front/master pair) after scaling by the global music factor. Params: volume1, volume2 = floats 0.0-1.0 scaled against settings. Use for live music fades.
rationale: r2dec header shows exactly 2 args; body is dense fp_stack math multiplying both by global float - proves float type and duplicate-name bug fixed.

name: MusicSetSfxVolume
note: Sets the SFX bus volume feeding the music/sound mix path. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0 scaled by global factor. Use for live SFX fade.
rationale: single arg_4h confirmed; float type inferred from the fp-math family shared with MusicSetVolume (both scale by the same globals).

name: Game_SetMusicVolume
note: Live-sets music volume through the profile real-value setter (fcn.004B8A50): retail body constructs 1.0f (0x3FF00000) and stores via fstp. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Called by ingamemenu.qvm options sliders.
rationale: body builds IEEE float 0x3FF00000 and routes through the same float setter Config_GraphicOptionsSetGamma uses -> param is float, old 'int volume' wrong. Caller proof: ingamemenu.qvm references Game_SetMusicVolume. | Cross-check pending in Ghidra session 816dfc8f (param_N + 0x3FF00000 scan).

name: Game_SetSFXVolume
note: Live-sets sound-effects volume through the profile real-value setter (fcn.004B8A50), same 1.0f construction pattern. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Called by ingamemenu.qvm options sliders.
rationale: identical float-construction + setter-routing evidence as Game_SetMusicVolume; old 'int volume' wrong. | Cross-check pending in Ghidra session 816dfc8f (param_N + 0x3FF00000 scan).

name: Mem_Alloc
note: Engine heap allocator. Params: numBytes = bytes to allocate, tag = allocation bucket shown in the 'Total allocated by user' accounting. RETURNS pointer or 0 on failure (error text: 'Mem_Alloc() failed to allocate %d bytes'). Pair with MemoryDealloc/MemDealloc free path.
rationale: r2dec header shows 2 args (arg_4h,arg_ch); body returns eax (pointer). Old 'void' return wrong; param names clarified from embedded accounting error string @0x546E3C.

name: StatusMessageShow
signature: int StatusMessageShow(int status_timer,char* msg,char* sprite,int status_byte);
note: Displays an on-screen STATUS MESSAGE (the HUD text that also drives FiberPool pumping!). Params: status_timer = display duration ticks, msg = text, sprite = optional icon sprite, status_byte = style/color selector. RETURNS handle/eax. Keep one visible message pumping FiberPool::RunPending in your mods.
rationale: r2dec header confirms 4 args (arg_14h/24h/30h/34h); returns eax -> scalar int more accurate than 'int*'.

name: ScriptInit
signature: void ScriptInit(char* file_name,int8_t p2,int p3,int8_t p4);
note: Initialises the script system for a file. Params: file_name = script path, p2 = byte flag (observed), p3 = int option, p4 = byte flag. Refined types from decompiled header (two int8_t slots detected).
rationale: r2dec header types two parameters as int8_t - old all-int placeholder refined.
